item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:50 HKT 03/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will bring heavy showers and thunderstorms to southern China in the next couple of days. With the trough of low pressure departing, showers will lessen over the region. An area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the South China Sea early next week and may develop into a tropical cyclone, but there are uncertainties in its track and intensity.

Date/Month: 03/08 (Wednesday)
Wind: South force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times.
Temp range: 27 - 31 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
